info.title: Room Management Admin API
info.description: Secure ADMIN-only catalog operations. Authentication uses HttpOnly session cookies. Public availability, quote, booking HOLD and guest-access routes are published separately in docs/openapi/public-v1.json.

200.description: Masked, safe payment summaries with bounded pagination.
Redacted payment detail including booking reference, masked attempts, masked provider refs, event timeline, reconciliation, audit and operational review.
Triggers a provider query. The endpoint never fabricates a SUCCESS outcome and never mutates the payment status directly; only the provided reconciliation state is returned.

get.summary: Read server-aggregated operational metrics for the current property.

200.description: Property-scoped metrics aggregated on the server; outstanding revenue is null until partial payments are modeled.

get.summary: Read physical-room occupancy, housekeeping and maintenance state from the server.

200.description: Removal result for the room-type / amenity pair.
Updated internal housekeeping state for a physical room.
Maintenance blocks ordered by start time.
Created maintenance block and inventory ledger allocation.
Cancelled maintenance block and released inventory allocation.
Rate plans with a price entry for every active price tier.

201.description: Created rate plan in DRAFT status.

200.description: Updated rate-plan price. The endpoint returns no response body.
Updated rate-plan price. The endpoint returns no response body.
Coupon detail with derived lifecycle and aggregate counts.
Disabled coupon. Existing reservations remain valid.

201.description: An idempotent transactional-outbox request; no coupon lifecycle state changes.

post.summary: Verify a signed booking access pass and return the next ADMIN lifecycle action.

200.description: A token-free booking preview. Check-in and check-out remain separate ADMIN-confirmed actions.

cookieAuth.name: rm_admin_session_v1
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure-in-production administrator session cookie. The raw token is never returned in any JSON body.

ValidationError.description: The request body or idempotency key is invalid.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

AuthenticationRequired.description: A valid active ADMIN session is required.

PermissionDenied.description: The current session lacks a required permission.

CatalogConflict.description: The requested catalog mutation conflicts with existing data.

BookingAccessPassInvalid.description: The booking access pass is invalid, expired, revoked, or not actionable.

CouponDeliveryBookingNotFound.description: No booking contact exists for the specified booking code.

CouponDeliveryConflict.description: Coupon availability changed or the idempotency key was reused with a different request.

AdminPaymentNotFound.description: No payment exists for the requested id within the active property scope.

AdminPaymentReconciliationConflict.description: The reconciliation request was rejected because the payment state changed since the request was prepared (expectedAttemptId / expectedUpdatedAt mismatch).

AdminPaymentReconciliationRateLimited.description: The reconciliation request was rate limited by the provider adapter; retry after the provided timestamp.
